title: Task and session pages: preview cards, no more columns

owner_note.text: The deputy/roles page now opens as one full page with its tabs, and the deputy page lists its four tasks as preview cards. Clicking a card opens that task's page in place of the list, and Back returns to the cards. The cut-off first column was not the sidebar covering it: the row had scrolled sideways to the newest column. Miller columns stay in the code as opt-in, and the rule is written in the navigation design readme.
